sources.entry: VoucherVault - Store and manage vouchers, coupons, loyalty and gift cards digitally. Supports expiry notifications, transaction histories, file uploads and OIDC SSO. GPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: VoucherVault is a Django web application for storing and managing vouchers, coupons, loyalty cards and gift cards digitally, with a mobile-friendly PWA interface.
summary.what_it_does: It lets users record vouchers, coupons, gift cards and loyalty cards, and attach item-specific file uploads (images and PDFs) to each entry. Redeem codes can be displayed as QR codes or barcodes, and codes can be scanned client-side (1D/2D) via camera or file upload when creating an item. Gift cards have transaction history tracking. Items can be shared between users, and the app supports multiple users, multiple languages (English, German, French, Italian) and light/dark themes. Expiry notifications are sent through Apprise, checked daily at 9AM via Celery Beat, with configurable thresholds. A REST API endpoint provides stats for Home Assistant and other dashboards.
use_cases: store gift cards and loyalty cards digitally
track gift card balance and transaction history
get reminders before vouchers or coupons expire
show redeem codes as barcodes or QR codes at checkout
share vouchers with other household members
feed voucher stats into a Home Assistant dashboard
how_to_run: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose-sqlite.yml logs -f (to obtain the auto-generated admin password)
notable: Single Sign-On via OIDC with configurable provider endpoints
Client-side barcode/QR scanning with automatic code type detection during item creation
Expiry notifications via Apprise with configurable day thresholds
Manual offline mode with 48h caching and PWA support
Multi-currency support via the fixer.io API
caveats: Container runs as www-data (UID/GID 33), so the bind mount permissions must be adjusted manually
Transaction history tracking applies to gift cards only
Multi-currency support depends on the free fixer.io API
